facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy page says the Head of State promulgated loi n°015/2014 instituting and organising the National Statistical System, while noting that the 1983 ministry-organisation decree still defines the statistics directorate's missions; the page gives no promulgation date, so the year comes from the law's number.
facts.system: Loi n°015/2014 portant institution et organisation du Système Statistique National

systems.system: Direction Générale de la Statistique (Institut National de la Statistique)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Économie et des Participations
